Description: Three-axle low-entry bus with the drivetrain of an Iveco Crossway LE 14.5 m: Cursor 9 diesel (400 PS / 1700 Nm), 4.63 final drive. Needs the Wentward Pack. ZF EcoLife 6-speed automatic with output retarder (auto mode with the brake pedal, levels on Alt+Y / Alt+H), speed limiter at 100 km/h.
